title: NDPA 2023 / GAID 2025 readiness register
note: Clause references come from secondary legal summaries and are pending review against the official NDPA and GAID texts. Correct an entry here and bump the version.

requirements.title: Personal data protected in transit
requirements.summary: Websites that may carry personal data use a valid TLS certificate and tell browsers to use HTTPS only (HSTS).
requirements.checks_performed: Certificate validity and expiry, and the HSTS header, on each in-scope web host.
requirements.not_checked: HTTP-to-HTTPS redirects, cipher strength, older protocol versions, internal systems and email transport.
requirements.remediation_hint: Renew certificates before they expire and send Strict-Transport-Security with includeSubDomains.

requirements.title: Web security headers and software banners
requirements.summary: Web responses send standard protective headers and do not advertise software versions.
requirements.checks_performed: Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Server and X-Powered-By headers on each in-scope web host's first response.
requirements.not_checked: Application logic, authentication, pages other than the first response, and APIs.
requirements.remediation_hint: Add the missing headers at your web server or CDN and remove version banners.

requirements.title: Internet-exposed services inventoried
requirements.summary: The services each in-scope host exposes to the internet have been listed, so unexpected ones can be found.
requirements.checks_performed: A port inventory of each in-scope host. The open ports found are listed with the evidence.
requirements.not_checked: Whether each open service should be exposed, and how it is secured. Review the listed ports.
requirements.remediation_hint: Review the listed open ports and close or restrict any service that does not need to be public.

requirements.title: Testing for known vulnerabilities
requirements.summary: Exposed systems are tested against known-vulnerability (CVE) templates and matches are followed up.
requirements.checks_performed: Known-CVE templates: matches reported; clean results not proven.
requirements.not_checked: A clean result. Template runs report matches only, so the absence of a match is never shown as evidence.
requirements.remediation_hint: Patch or isolate the affected software for each reported match.

requirements.title: Email anti-spoofing records
requirements.summary: The domain publishes SPF and an enforcing DMARC policy, which makes forged email harder to deliver.
requirements.checks_performed: The SPF record and DMARC policy published for the scanned domain.
requirements.not_checked: DKIM, every SPF mechanism and DMARC reporting, and subdomains other than the scanned domain.
requirements.remediation_hint: Publish SPF ending in -all and move DMARC to p=quarantine or p=reject.

requirements.title: Periodic risk assessment
requirements.summary: Each verified domain has a recent assessment in which every declared check finished.
requirements.checks_performed: Completed scans with complete declared-check coverage, per verified domain, within the window.
requirements.not_checked: Risk assessments of systems Cyphward does not scan, and organisational risks.
requirements.remediation_hint: Keep daily scans on and fix whatever stops a scan from finishing every declared check.

requirements.title: Regular testing of security measures
requirements.summary: Each verified domain was tested in the last 30 days, with every declared check finished.
requirements.checks_performed: Completed scans with complete declared-check coverage, per verified domain, within the window.
requirements.not_checked: Testing of internal systems, staff procedures and suppliers.
requirements.remediation_hint: Keep daily scans on and fix whatever stops a scan from finishing every declared check.

requirements.title: Privacy policy published
requirements.summary: A privacy policy is reachable from the website.
requirements.remediation_hint: Publish a privacy policy and link it from every page footer.
requirements.checks_performed: A static fetch of each checked website's homepage, links to a privacy policy, and common addresses such as /privacy. A page counts only when its title names privacy and it differs from the homepage.
requirements.not_checked: Pages built by JavaScript, the policy's quality or completeness, and websites Cyphward does not scan.

requirements.title: Cookie notice published
requirements.summary: A cookie notice explains which cookies the website sets and why.
requirements.remediation_hint: Publish a cookie notice listing each cookie and its purpose.
requirements.checks_performed: A static fetch of each checked website's homepage, links to a cookie notice, and common addresses such as /cookies.
requirements.not_checked: Pages built by JavaScript and whether the notice lists every cookie.

requirements.title: Consent banner visible without scrolling
requirements.summary: Visitors see the cookie consent banner on arrival.
requirements.remediation_hint: Show the consent banner in the first screen a visitor sees.

requirements.title: Accept and reject options
requirements.summary: The banner offers a reject option as well as accept.
requirements.remediation_hint: Give equal prominence to Accept and Reject.

requirements.title: No non-essential cookies before consent
requirements.summary: Analytics and advertising cookies or trackers load only after the visitor agrees.
requirements.remediation_hint: Load analytics and advertising tags only after consent.
requirements.checks_performed: Cookies set on the first response and tracker scripts in the homepage HTML, including whether a consent manager blocks them.
requirements.not_checked: Trackers loaded later by scripts or tag managers. Only a browser test can show that nothing loads before consent, so this check can show gaps but never evidence present.

requirements.title: Purpose and withdrawal explained
requirements.summary: The banner or notice explains each purpose and how to withdraw consent later.
requirements.remediation_hint: Explain each cookie purpose and add a way to change consent later.

requirements.title: Data protection officer designated
requirements.summary: The organisation has named a data protection officer.
requirements.remediation_hint: Name a DPO and record the appointment.

requirements.title: DPO contact published
requirements.summary: The DPO's contact details are published, for example in the privacy policy.
requirements.remediation_hint: Publish a DPO contact address in the privacy policy.
requirements.checks_performed: Whether a DPO contact (an email address near 'data protection officer' or 'DPO') appears in a fetched privacy policy. Heuristic.
requirements.not_checked: Whether the contact works, and policies Cyphward could not fetch. You can also confirm this yourself in a later release.

requirements.title: DPO reports to management
requirements.summary: The DPO reports directly to senior management.
requirements.remediation_hint: Record the DPO's reporting line to senior management.

requirements.title: Six-monthly DPO report
requirements.summary: The DPO prepares a data protection report every six months.
requirements.remediation_hint: Schedule the DPO's six-monthly report.

requirements.title: Major-importance status recorded
requirements.summary: The organisation has recorded whether it is a data controller or processor of major importance, and its tier (UHL, EHL or OHL).
requirements.remediation_hint: Record your major-importance status and tier.

requirements.title: Registration with the Commission
requirements.summary: A data controller or processor of major importance has registered with the Nigeria Data Protection Commission.
requirements.remediation_hint: Register with the Commission and keep the confirmation.

requirements.title: Annual Compliance Audit Return filed through a DPCO
requirements.summary: A UHL or EHL organisation files its annual audit return through a licensed DPCO by 31 March.
requirements.remediation_hint: Engage a licensed DPCO before 31 March.

requirements.title: Breach response plan
requirements.summary: A written plan says who does what when personal data is breached.
requirements.remediation_hint: Write and circulate a breach response plan.

requirements.title: 72-hour notification process
requirements.summary: There is a process to notify the Commission within 72 hours of becoming aware of a breach.
requirements.remediation_hint: Document who notifies the Commission and how, within 72 hours.

requirements.title: Incident log
requirements.summary: Breaches and suspected breaches are logged with their dates and actions.
requirements.remediation_hint: Keep an incident log, even when there are no incidents.

requirements.title: Impact assessment for high-risk processing
requirements.summary: Processing likely to pose a high risk to people has a data protection impact assessment.
requirements.remediation_hint: Carry out a DPIA before starting high-risk processing.

requirements.title: Lawful basis documented per purpose
requirements.summary: Each processing purpose has its lawful basis written down.
requirements.remediation_hint: List each processing purpose with its lawful basis.

requirements.title: Consent records kept
requirements.summary: Where consent is the basis, records show who agreed, to what and when.
requirements.remediation_hint: Store consent records with the date, wording and person.

requirements.title: Data subject request process
requirements.summary: There is a process to handle access, correction, portability and erasure requests.
requirements.remediation_hint: Publish how people can make requests and track each one to completion.

requirements.title: Cross-border transfers identified
requirements.summary: Transfers of personal data outside Nigeria are listed with the basis relied on.
requirements.remediation_hint: List each foreign recipient or hosting location and its transfer basis.

requirements.title: Privacy and security training
requirements.summary: Staff who handle personal data receive privacy and security training.
requirements.remediation_hint: Run training at least yearly and keep attendance records.
